system_role: You are an Oscar-winning Pixar/Hollywood movie trailer writer, character visual director, and savage pet behavior profiler. Scan the 3 uploaded pet photos for exact breed markings, fur color, eye color, ear shape, collar details, and guilty/derpy expression. Return ONLY valid JSON matching the schema below.

output_schema.movie_title: ALL-CAPS blockbuster title featuring the pet's name and signature crime (e.g., 'BARNABY: THE CHEDDAR HEIST' or 'AGENT MOCHI: ZOOMIES PROTOCOL')
output_schema.movie_tagline: Punchy Hollywood movie poster tagline under 12 words (e.g., 'No counter is safe. No cheese is sacred.')
output_schema.brutal_bio_roast: A 1-2 sentence hilarious, brutally accurate bio roast calling out the pet's exact expression and domestic crimes (max 32 words).

pawsport_id_card.fur_and_collar_lock: Exact visual description of fur markings, snout, ears, and collar locked for Flux IP-Adapter / PuLID.

indicted_crimes.desc: Executed a silent zero-gravity leap onto the kitchen island to liberate 14oz of aged sharp cheddar.
Deploys guilt-inducing puppy eyes within 0.4 seconds of shredding a $60 throw pillow.
Initiates full-throttle hardwood drift racing across the hallway at 3:14 AM sharp.

output_schema.trailer_voiceover_script_40w: Exactly 40-word 'Epic Movie Trailer Guy' voiceover script split into 3 timed segments: [0:00-0:03] Real photo hook calling out their guilty face, [0:03-0:10] Cinematic roast of their 3 crimes, [0:10-0:15] Reveal of the framed movie poster + CTA.
trailer_timed_captions: 0:00–0:03 • In a world where no kitchen counter is safe... meet {{1.pet_name}}.
0:03–0:10 • Part angel, part domestic terrorist. Wanted in 4 states for grand theft cheese and 3AM zoomies.
0:10–0:15 • Coming this summer: '{{movie_title}}'. Comment PAW to turn your pet into a movie star!

Expressive cinematic lighting, dramatic heist action pose, native 3D movie title text '{{movie_title}}' at the top and credits block at bottom, 8k octane render.
flux_pulid_poster_prompts.poster_2_action_epic: Hollywood IMAX action blockbuster movie poster starring the exact pet from the reference photo (preserving exact fur pattern and facial markings). Tactical hero vest, cinematic orange-and-teal rim lighting, sparks and dramatic city bokeh background, bold metallic title '{{movie_title}}', photorealistic 8k.
flux_pulid_poster_prompts.poster_3_noir_royalty: Wes Anderson / Prestige Detective Noir theatrical poster starring the exact pet from the reference photo (preserving exact breed markings and eyes). Velvet detective cape, dramatic golden hour chiaroscuro lighting, vintage cinema typography '{{movie_title}}', ultra-detailed studio portrait.
